info.title: Mkatolik Catholic Content API
info.description: Reviewed Catholic editorial library. Public readers never receive drafts or review notes. Plain-text bodies are rendered as text, not HTML. Scheduling uses the existing Laravel scheduler. Media is private until attached to a visible published post. No reading-history or advertising profiles are recorded.

get.summary: Paginated editorial or recent public feed
Public posts; same pagination and filters as content/feed
Search title, summary, body, category and tags
Published posts in an active category
Published translated reader with full plain-text body
Up to six visible posts sharing categories or tags

200.description: Envelope containing an array of public posts

get.summary: Automatic daily Catholic Mass reading references
get.description: Public endpoint, no login or API key required. Uses today's date in Africa/Dar_es_Salaam and the cpbjr Catholic Readings API's USCCB calendar. References only; no scripture text or reflection is generated. Normalizes English book names into locale-neutral book identifiers for translation by clients. Caches per date on first request; no scheduler or editorial publication is required. Tries the official GitHub repository mirror if GitHub Pages fails. Returns 503 for missing, malformed or wrong-date data; never substitutes another day's readings. Full readings link opens English USCCB text externally. This is not a Tanzania-specific liturgical calendar.

200.description: Today's reading references in the standard data envelope

503.description: Provider data unavailable. Standard error envelope with code DAILY_READINGS_UNAVAILABLE.

get.summary: Reviewed daily reflection for language and date
get.description: Date defaults to today in Africa/Dar_es_Salaam. Returns data:null when no published reviewed reflection exists. A reflection can have been published before its assigned date; no readings are invented or filled in automatically.

200.description: PublicPost or null in the data envelope

get.summary: Stream authorized media attached to a published post
get.description: Private local storage; paths are never disclosed. Supports standard byte-range requests through BinaryFileResponse, including audio seeking. Returns 404 for draft-only, unknown-rights or withdrawn assets. No-store and nosniff response headers. Rate limit: 600/minute/IP.

post.summary: Report published content for editorial review
post.description: No personal information is requested or stored. Reports do not automatically hide content. Limit: ten reports/day/IP, plus the configurable content public limit (240 requests/minute/IP by default). Only hashed IP rate-limit keys are retained temporarily.

get.summary: Authenticated account's own bookmarks, excluding withdrawn content
Return own bookmark status without exposing any post data

delete.summary: Idempotently remove own bookmark, including withdrawn posts

get.summary: Paginated drafts and publications available to this editor
get.description: content.manage and directory:read required. Authors see only their posts; content.review users can inspect all posts.

post.summary: Create a draft and its translations, categories and reflection dates

get.summary: Authorized draft preview including translations, reviews and reflection dates

patch.summary: Replace editable content; reset approval and withdraw any prior publication
patch.description: Full editable payload required. Author identity, review decisions and status cannot be set through this payload.

delete.summary: Soft-delete an owned draft; publications must be archived instead

post.summary: Submit, independently review, publish, schedule, unpublish or archive
post.description: Draft → in_review → approved → published → archived. Rejection and unpublishing return to draft. Authors cannot review themselves. Approval requires confirmed text/media rights, an active category and a Kiswahili translation. schedule/publish/archive/unpublish require content.publish. Transitions and notes are audited. Scheduled publication runs every minute through the existing scheduler.

scheduled_at.description: Required future instant for schedule; include timezone

get.summary: Categories, up to 1000 tags, up to 500 authors and review/publish capabilities

post.summary: Create a category or tag; requires content.publish

patch.summary: Update a category or tag; deactivating categories removes them from discovery

get.summary: Paginated authorized media selection; 30 assets/page, no storage paths

post.summary: Upload private authorized image/audio with source and rights metadata

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP: max 5 MiB and 6000x6000 pixels. MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV: max 20 MiB. SVG/HTML/executables are rejected. Files remain private until approved publication.

alt_text.description: Required for image uploads; describe the image accessibly.

patch.summary: Mark a report reviewed; archive or unpublish its post separately if appropriate

get.summary: Privately preview a draft image or recording before publication
get.description: Requires content.manage and directory:read, plus asset ownership or content.review. Unknown-rights assets remain inspectable privately by authorized staff; this does not publish them. Supports byte ranges. Paths and bearer tokens must never be put in a public preview URL.

schema.description: icon, sort_order and is_active are required for categories.

Success.description: Standard envelope: success:true, data (operation result), meta:{}

Page.description: Paginated public content. Bodies are omitted until detail is requested.

AdminPage.description: Paginated editorial posts, with translations, categories, tags and author. Includes private draft state only for authorized editors.

Error.description: Standard error envelope; validation fields appear under error.details

source_url.description: HTTPS; required together with source_name for official sources

reflections.description: Reflection posts only. Unique date/locale and post/locale, matching a translation; duplicate reservation returns 409.

reflection_date.description: Assigned reflection date for the requested locale; distinct from published_at.
